gate_israel_payout_no_camera.evidence: There are two routes. (a) Stripe Express. PromptBase offers Express accounts where Stripe is otherwise unavailable (snippet). Algora's code lists Israel as a Connect Express country (REJECTED.md:1414-1417, rendered at github grade in the repo). Express KYC asks for legal name, Israeli ID, DOB, address and a bank account, and 'Stripe may request an ID document upload'; no selfie is named (research/colony-sweep/scouts/bounties-grants--oss-bounties.md:115-117). A Stripe payout needs an account at least 30 days old and a $30 balance (snippet). (b) Zoneless. It pays USDC to the seller's Solana wallet (github zonelessdev/zoneless apps/docs payouts.ts and platform-dashboard.ts). Above a threshold the marketplace sets, payouts pause until the seller uploads 'a valid identity document and complete[s] a selfie check' via Didit (github identity-verification.ts). That is a camera step. Converting USDC to ILS then needs Israeli VASP KYC (kyc-catalogue:248-252). So route (b) effectively FAILs, and route (a) is settled by the outcome of owner step 4.

gate_programmatic_listing.evidence: No seller API exists as far as I could find. A GitHub code search for PromptBase listing automation (Playwright, Selenium, upload) returned 0 hits on 28.9. Each prompt is submitted through a web form with a test generation that must match the submitted examples, then reviewed by hand in 15 minutes to 36 hours (snippet). The colony can write the prompts and outputs headlessly. The container cannot reach promptbase.com, though, and whether a runner may drive the brand account's form is unread in PromptBase's terms. If only the owner can submit, this gate FAILs: one owner click per prompt.

gate_ai_allowed_honest.evidence: AI is the declared product: buyers purchase prompts for AI models, and every example output is AI-made by definition. Review includes an 'AI assessment for similarity' (snippet). Whether the terms require the prompt text itself to be written by a human is UNKNOWN (terms unread). The colony would say on its profile that the prompts are AI-engineered and tested.
